title: KV-Store — Persistent Key-Value Store with TTL and Snapshot API
raw_goal:
# KV-Store
Build a lightweight persistent key-value store with TTL expiration, snapshot creation, and CLI inspection in Python 3 stdlib.

## Requirements
1. R1: Basic CRUD — Support set(key, value), get(key), delete(key), and has(key).
2. R2: TTL Expiration — Configurable time-to-live per key with automatic lazy or periodic expiration.
3. R3: Snapshot Dump & Load — Create atomic snapshot file on disk and restore from snapshot.
4. R4: CLI Interface — Command line interface: kvstore get <key>, kvstore set <key> <val> [--ttl <sec>], kvstore snapshot <file>.
5. R5: Unit Test Suite — Comprehensive deterministic tests in tests/ covering CRUD, TTL, and snapshots.
